signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.failed: Sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.
signIn.disabled: Your account has been disabled. Ask your administrator if you think this is a mistake.
signIn.sessionRevoked: Your session has ended. Sign in again — if your account was re-enabled, choose a new password with “Forgot your password?”.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account's email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a link to reset its password is on its way. It works once and expires in one hour. You can ask for another in a few minutes.

confirm.inviteDescription: Continue to confirm your email address, then choose your password.
confirm.recoveryDescription: Continue to choose a new password.
confirm.invalidInvite: It has expired or was already used. Ask your administrator to send a new invitation.
confirm.invalidRecovery: It has expired or was already used. Request a new link below.
confirm.malformed: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.description: Use at least {min} characters. A long phrase is stronger than a short, complicated word.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.weak: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
setPassword.same: Choose a password different from your current one.
setPassword.failed: The password could not be saved. Try again.
setPassword.noSession: Your link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
